stories.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
stories.simple_summary: A company called Elorian made an AI model that can look at pictures and charts and understand what they mean, and it does this better than some other AI systems. It's especially good at reading scientific charts and describing videos.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to researchers and engineers building new AI tools. There's nothing you need to do about it right now.

stories.title: Jev is Vercel’s fastest-adopted AI model ever
stories.simple_summary: A new AI model called Jev became very popular very quickly among people using Vercel's service, which is a platform developers use to build websites and applications.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to software developers and tech investors. It doesn't affect your daily life or small business unless you're a web developer.

stories.title: A week with RTX Spark: everything we’ve learned using Nvidia’s new laptops
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia made new laptop processors called RTX Spark that are meant to be very fast and powerful, competing with similar chips from Apple and other companies.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're thinking about buying a new laptop soon, RTX Spark laptops might be worth looking at as an option, though they'll probably be expensive.

stories.title: Mark Wahlberg on using AI in film ‘the right way’ and being open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy
stories.simple_summary: Actor Mark Wahlberg said he thinks using AI in making movies can be okay if it's used to help improve the film, and he might even be open to an AI version of himself being used in future projects.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about how Hollywood works and doesn't affect you or a small business owner in a practical way.

stories.title: Meta’s new terms may allow it to train AI on news sites for free
stories.simple_summary: Meta (which owns Facebook and Instagram) changed its rules so it can take articles and content from news websites and use them to train its AI systems without paying the news sites.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a website or business with online content, Meta may now use that content for free to improve its AI. News publishers are concerned about this.

stories.title: Veritas expands its anti-counterfeit chip to jewelry, trophies, and fragrance bottles
stories.simple_summary: A company called Veritas is putting tiny chips into products like jewelry, trophies, and perfume bottles to prove they're real and not fake copies.
stories.why_it_matters: If you buy luxury items or sell products online, this technology might help protect you from buying counterfeits, though it will only work if sellers actually use these chips.

stories.title: Replit’s CEO says the future of work is the ‘self-driving company’
stories.simple_summary: The leader of a software company called Replit thinks that in the future, AI will handle most daily tasks at companies and people will just make the big decisions.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a guess about the future from one company leader. It's honest to say we don't know if this will actually happen.

stories.title: Young Indians are learning to work alongside artificial intelligence
stories.simple_summary: Young people in India are learning how to work with AI tools as part of their education and careers.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows that learning about AI is becoming normal in schools around the world, though the details aren't provided here.

stories.title: COMMENTARY: AI jitters, Trump's fading oil clout and China shock 2.0: The financial week in five charts
stories.simple_summary: A financial news report looked at the week's biggest money stories, including concerns about AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people who follow stock markets. It's too vague to say what you should know.

stories.title: Democrats eyeing the presidency can’t stop talking about this issue
stories.simple_summary: Politicians running for president are talking a lot about a particular issue, though the headline doesn't say what it is.
stories.why_it_matters: Without knowing what issue they're discussing, it's hard to say whether this matters to you.

stories.title: Don’t Let Big Tech Dictate Humanity’s Future
stories.simple_summary: An opinion piece suggests that big tech companies shouldn't be allowed to control how AI develops and affects society.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a debate about policy and values rather than a news story about what's actually happening.

stories.title: Citizen Science Groups Grapple With the Rise of A.I. Slop
stories.simple_summary: Groups of regular people who do scientific research are noticing that AI is being used to create fake or low-quality information, making it harder to find real scientific data.
stories.why_it_matters: If you rely on internet research for hobbies or work, you may need to be more careful about checking whether information is real or made by AI.
